description: Check whether a date is a working day in India for banks in a state, NSE trading, NSE settlement or central government offices; get the previous and next working days, or the date N working days away (T+1 settlement: calendar settlement, add 1).

calendar.description: bank (needs state), market (NSE trading), settlement (NSE clearing) or central (central government offices).

office.description: Bank calendar only: one Reserve Bank office's list, such as Srinagar, for a state with several offices (Maharashtra, Uttar Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Kerala).

state.description: State code or name, for example TN or Tamil Nadu.

name: check_working_day
title: Check working day
